_comment: EXAMPLE / PRE-SEAL REHEARSAL ONLY. Not the campaign plan.
The real plan is written by scripts/seal_ladder.py into data/sealed/campaign_plan.json
and copied by hand to configs/campaign_plan.local.json, which is gitignored: it
names which sealed id is the exploratory arm, and committing that would unblind
This file exists so the format is documented and so run_campaign.py --validate-only
can be rehearsed against the plain model names before sealing. Its ids are
placeholders and its served names are the pre-seal plain names, so it reveals
nothing the preregistration does not already state.
After sealing, every `served` value is the candidate id itself.
